title.zh: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments
title.en: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments

current_state.zh: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
current_state.en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
